summary: Elong Power Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignation of CFO Wei Zou effective June 11, 2026, with no disagreement with company operations, policies, or procedures. The Board immediately appointed Yue Liu as CFO on the same date. Ms. Liu, a CPA with extensive finance and IPO experience, will serve under a one-year renewable employment agreement with annual compensation of RMB420,000 (approx. US$60,000). No advisor or board recommendation is mentioned. This is a routine executive transition, not a forced departure, thus categorized as Management Changes. No risk-arb angle applies.
